terms.description: Spaced-repetition flashcard program that asbplayer exports cards to. Do not translate.
The dialog where an Anki card is configured before being exported.
Anki add-on that lets asbplayer communicate with a running Anki instance. Do not translate.
On-screen details attached to subtitle words: color, reading, frequency, definition and pitch accent.
The name of this app. Do not translate.
Playback mode that pauses playback automatically at each subtitle.
In this app, always an Anki flashcard.
Estimated percentage of the media's unique words that the user knows, weighted by word maturity and how often each word occurs.
Playback mode that skips over sections of the video without subtitles.
In Anki, a named collection of flashcards. Use Anki's own localization if one exists.
Playback mode that plays at an increased rate, except for selected subtitles which play at normal rate.
How common a word is, based on its rank in the user's frequency dictionaries.
Word maturity between Learning and Young: the word's Anki cards have completed Anki's learning stage.
Language-learning jargon for a sentence with exactly one unknown word, making it ideal to mine. Keep as-is.
Word state that deliberately excludes a word from known-status word matching and from comprehension statistics.
Japanese subtitle repository used by the online subtitle search. Do not translate.
Words with a maturity of Learning or above.
A word's dictionary form; for example, the lemma of "goes" is "go".
Highest word maturity: a word whose Anki cards have been reviewed successfully over a long time.
How well a word is known: one of Uncollected, Unknown, Learning, Graduated, Young or Mature, in increasing order.
Parser used by Yomitan to segment Japanese text into words. Do not translate.
To create a flashcard from the current subtitle and its media. The noun form is "mining".
In Anki, the template that defines the fields and layout of new notes. Use Anki's own localization if one exists.
A way of playing the video: Normal, Auto-pause, Condensed, Fast-forward or Repeat.
A saved, switchable set of settings.
A named, shareable combination of playback modes and settings for a learning activity.
Regular expression, a text-matching pattern. Commonly left untranslated.
Playback mode that plays each subtitle a configured number of times.
Image of the video captured at the current subtitle, used as a card's image.
The browser's built-in side panel feature; use the browser's own localization.
Video played on a website and synced with asbplayer via the extension, as opposed to a video file opened in the app.
Time shift applied to subtitle timestamps so that they line up with the video.
One of the loaded subtitle streams, labeled "Track 1", "Track 2" or "Track 3".
Lowest word maturity: the word is not in any of the user's word databases.
Word maturity between Uncollected and Learning: the word is not being learned.
Japanese vocabulary learning service that asbplayer can collect known words from. Do not translate.
One complete viewing pass of the media, as in "Current watch" and "Rewatch".
asbplayer's collection of the user's words, built from Anki, WaniKani and local imports.
Browser dictionary extension used for word lookups. Do not translate.
